title: FourStat: A Dual AutoEncoder Leveraging Frequency and Stationarity for Time Series Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.32714v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While numerous studies have focused on multivariate time series anomaly detection, many existing methods perform poorly or are not directly applicable to univariate settings. We introduce FourStat, a dual-model framework for univariate time series anomaly detection that combines two complementary approaches. The Fourier Autoencoder (FAE) captures global patterns like seasonality through frequency-domain analysis, while the Stationary Autoencoder (SAE) focuses on local structures by enforcing statistical stationarity. We also propose a new evaluation metric called Perfect Point that assesses whether perfect F1-scores can be achieved directly from anomaly scores, eliminating thresholding subjectivity. Results demonstrate that FourStat outperforms existing baselines, particularly on challenging anomaly types, while the new metric provides clearer insights into model performance gaps and advantages.

translated_title: FourStat：一种利用频率与平稳性的双自编码器时间序列异常检测方法
translated_abstract: 尽管大量研究聚焦于多变量时间序列异常检测，但许多现有方法在单变量场景下表现不佳或无法直接应用。我们提出了FourStat，一个用于单变量时间序列异常检测的双模型框架，它结合了两种互补的方法。傅里叶自编码器（FAE）通过频域分析捕捉季节性等全局模式，而平稳自编码器（SAE）通过强化统计平稳性来关注局部结构。我们还提出了一种名为Perfect Point的新评估指标，用于评估能否直接从异常分数中获得完美的F1分数，从而消除阈值选择的主观性。结果表明，FourStat优于现有基线方法，尤其是在具有挑战性的异常类型上，同时新指标能更清晰地揭示模型性能的差距与优势。
tldr: 提出FourStat双自编码器框架，结合频域分析的傅里叶自编码器与强化统计平稳性的平稳自编码器来检测单变量时间序列异常，并引入Perfect Point新指标以消除阈值选择的主观性。
en_tdlr: FourStat, a dual autoencoder framework combining a Fourier Autoencoder for global frequency patterns and a Stationary Autoencoder for local structures in univariate time series anomaly detection, together with a new threshold-free metric called Perfect Point.
